examples.content:
Base vs Arbitrum vs Optimism - which L2 to bet on?

Base:
+ Coinbase backing = normie onboarding
+ Fast growing TVL
- Newer, less battle-tested

Arbitrum:
+ Highest TVL ($2.5B)
+ Most dApps
- Slower innovation

Optimism:
+ Tech leader (OP Stack)
+ Strong community
- Lower TVL

My take: Diversify across all three
